aggressive_definition: aggressive prostate cancer; no further criteria are specified in the supplied abstract
aggressive_definition_excerpt: For aggressive prostate cancer, there were positive associations with six glycerophospholipids (LPC C17:0, LPC C20:3, LPC C20:4, PC ae C38:3, PC ae C38:4 and PC ae C40:2), while there was an inverse association with acylcarnitine C18:2.
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study using prediagnostic plasma samples.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: In a case-control study nested in the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study, pre-diagnostic concentrations of 148 plasma metabolites were determined using targeted mass spectrometry- and nuclear magnetic resonance-based metabolomics in 777 prostate cancer cases (follow-up ≥ 5 years) and 777 matched controls.
reason: The study prospectively analyzed plasma metabolites for overall prostate cancer and after stratification by disease aggressiveness. Thus, it analyzed both general and aggressive incident prostate cancer endpoints.
